root.label: Democrats regain voter registration ground in key states

events.label: Democrats regain voter registration ground in key states

slots.name: party registration margin
slots.sentence: From late 2024 through late 2025, Republicans significantly improved their voter registration margin over Democrats in all seven states, including by a net of roughly 100,000 in Pennsylvania and North Carolina.

slots.name: Pennsylvania net gain
slots.sentence: But from the end of last year to this summer, Democrats gained a net of around 46,000.

slots.name: new voter gain
slots.sentence: Despite those big 2025 losses, Democrats actually gained around 22,000 registrants from new voters over that period.

slots.name: party switch losses
slots.sentence: But that was offset by net losses from party registration switches (about 43,000)

slots.name: registration staffers
slots.sentence: About 150 staffers are now “having conversations with people in every single corner of our commonwealth, listening to their concerns, listening to their issues and making a case of why they should register as Democrats,” he said, while also crediting Trump’s growing unpopularity.

slots.name: Pennsylvania vote margin
slots.sentence: It all adds up in a state Trump won by 120,000 votes in 2024.

slots.name: turnout leavers
slots.sentence: For example, in Pennsylvania, the 2024 turnout among people who subsequently left the rolls was 37%, compared with 81% for those who stayed.

slots.name: party registration states
slots.sentence: A total of 30 states and Washington, D.C., register voters by party, while the rest — including battlegrounds like Georgia, Michigan and Wisconsin — do not.

slots.name: registration mechanisms
slots.sentence: There are three primary ways the party registration margin can change: new voters signing up; registrants switching parties; or registrants being removed from the rolls after having moved out of state, routine maintenance or dying.

slots.name: turnout stayers
slots.sentence: compared with 81% for those who stayed.

slots.name: North Carolina new gain
slots.sentence: they gave Democrats a net gain of around 6,000 this year.

slots.name: Pennsylvania GOP gain
slots.sentence: In battleground Pennsylvania, Republicans had their biggest net gain in voter registration (more than 110,000) from late 2024 to late 2025 of the seven states analyzed.

slots.name: North Carolina GOP gain
slots.sentence: From late 2024 to late 2025, Republicans’ net voter registration gain was just shy of 100,000.

slots.name: North Carolina Dem loss
slots.sentence: Democrats managed to keep the net loss to around 16,000 from late 2025 to last month.

slots.name: Pennsylvania new gain
slots.sentence: New registrants and party switchers gave Democrats net gains of around 45,000 and 11,000, respectively.

slots.name: NC GOP net gain registrants
slots.sentence: While new registrants gave Republicans a net gain of around 11,000 last year, they gave Democrats a net gain of around 6,000 this year.
